Kit summary

Wind PenetrationBasic
Deals 200% ATK DMG to a single enemy. If the target doesn't have [Ember] or [Burn], deals 210% extra ATK DMG that ignores DEF. If the target has [Ember] or [Burn], deals extra 210% ATK Detonation DMG.
Violent WindsActive
Deals 210% ATK DMG to all enemies. If the targets do not have [Ember], deals 210% extra ATK DMG that ignores DEF. If the targets have at least 1 layer of [Ember], then there is a 100% chance that each layer of [Ember] inflicts 1 layer of [Burn] on them for 2 turns.
Flame WindPassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.3
Whenever an ally deals Detonation DMG, O'Gradies grants the ally a [Wind Shelter] by 40% of her Max HP for 2 turns, up to 1 layer, during which additionally increases SPD by 40% ([Wind Shelter] cannot coexist with other effects that increase SPD). Besides, when an enemy takes Detonation DMG dealt by an ally other than O'Gradies, O'Gradies will inflict 1 layer of [Ember] on the enemy for 2 turns, up to 3 layers. Each layer of [Ember] increases 15% [Burn] DMG taken by the owner. If the owner is a Boss, increases [Burn] DMG taken by 30%.
Spirit Stone Lv.1At the beginning of each battle, O'Gradies additionally gains 0.6% (caps at 100%) Healing Effect and Shield Effect for every 1% of Mastery owned. Besides, restores 8% of Max HP for allies with [Wind Shelter] at the beginning of each turn.
Spirit Stone Lv.3At the beginning of allies' (excluding self) turn, deals 60% ATK [Burn] DMG to all enemies under [Burn] status. There is a 60% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Burn] on those who are not under [Burn] status for 2 turns.
Fiery WindActiveExclusive Lv.2
Deals 3 stages of 100% ATK DMG each to all enemies. If the targets are not under [Burn] status, there is a 80% chance to inflict 1 layer of [Burn] on them for 2 turns. If the targets are under [Burn] status, deals extra 100% ATK [Burn] DMG. The more layers of [Ember] the targets have, the more extra [Burn] DMG dealt, up to 200% ATK.
Spirit Stone Lv.2When each stage of Fiery Wind deals DMG, if the targets have less than 3 layers of [Ember], inflicts 1 layer of [Ember] for 2 turns. If the targets have 3 layers of [Ember], increases the extra [Burn] DMG dealt by 50%.
